title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
statement: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
hints: Maintain a sliding window [left, right] with unique characters.
Use a Map or Set to store characters inside the current window.
When duplicate is seen, advance left pointer past previous occurrence.

solutions.title: Set Sliding Window
Index Jump Map

editorial.approach: Sliding window with hash map: maintain a window [left, right] and a map storing the last seen index of each character. As right advances, if s[right] was seen at index last_idx >= left, contract the window by updating left = last_idx + 1. Record the current index map[s[right]] = right and update max_len = max(max_len, right - left + 1).
editorial.why_optimal: Both left and right pointers advance monotonically from left to right, processing the string in O(n) time and O(min(m, n)) space where m is the alphabet size.
editorial.pitfalls: Moving left backward if last_idx < left when the character was seen in an earlier, already-closed window; left must only move forward (left = max(left, last_idx + 1)).
